title: Figures 91-92: cylinder UAP Mach number at 100 mph and pressure at 200 mph CFD
description: Two CFD contour plots for the cylinder-shaped UAP model at 1/6 scale and 223K with subsonic inlet and outlet. Figure 91 shows Mach number distribution at 100 mph with a slow wake behind the blunt cylinder; Figure 92 shows the pressure field (Pa) at 200 mph with stagnation at the flat face. Start of the BAASS cylinder speed sweep.
